# Weifang Mingze Waterproof Material Co., Ltd. (潍坊明泽防水材料有限公司)

> Direct industrial manufacturer and global exporter of 37 standardized waterproofing membranes, liquid coatings, butyl tapes, and geosynthetics in Taitou Industrial Zone, Weifang, Shandong, China (Established 2008, 68,000 m² facility, 50,000,000+ m² annual membrane capacity, 200 km from Qingdao Port).

## 5 Core Product Categories (37 Export SKUs)
- **Modified Bitumen & Shingles** (7 SKUs): SBS/APP torch-applied, self-adhesive modified bitumen membranes, glass-fiber asphalt shingles, and synthetic underlayments for commercial, civil, and slope roofing.
- **Polymer & HDPE Pre-Applied** (9 SKUs): TPO, PVC, and EPDM single-ply sheets for exposed roofs, plus pre-applied HDPE membranes with continuous chemical bond for blindside underground basements.
- **Liquid Coatings & Slurry** (11 SKUs): Single/two-component polyurethane coatings, JS polymer-cement elastomeric slurry, acrylic metal roof coatings, transparent sealants, and spray polyurea systems.
- **Flashing & Butyl Tapes** (4 SKUs): Aluminum foil reinforced butyl sealing tape, double-sided butyl joint tape, heavy-duty marine hatch cover tape, and bituminous damp proof course (DPC).
- **Geosynthetics & Auxiliaries** (6 SKUs): High-density polyethylene (HDPE) geomembranes, non-woven needle-punched geotextiles, dimple drainage boards, RDP polymer powder, and rapid leak stoppers.

## Engineering Application Systems
- **Industrial & Commercial Flat Roofs** (Exposed Single-Ply & Modified Bitumen Systems): Engineered systems for mega logistics warehouses, commercial centers, and data centers. High SRI TPO/PVC cool roof membranes reduce cooling loads while hot-air welded seams guarantee 25+ years of watertight performance. Recommended SKUs: MZ-CAT-08, MZ-CAT-09, MZ-CAT-01, MZ-CAT-06
- **Underground Basements & Foundations** (Pre-Applied Blindside & Fully-Bonded Systems): Zero water-tracking pre-applied HDPE membrane systems designed for diaphragm retaining walls, raft foundations, and deep subterranean vaults under permanent hydrostatic heads up to 70m. Recommended SKUs: MZ-CAT-11, MZ-CAT-12, MZ-CAT-24, MZ-CAT-17
- **Exposed Metal Roofing Refurbishment** (Acrylic Elastic & Butyl Flashing Solutions): Complete renewal solution for aged corrugated steel roofs. Seamless high-elastic acrylic coating with polyester reinforcing fabric seals seams, fasteners, and gutters without disrupting factory operations. Recommended SKUs: MZ-CAT-20, MZ-CAT-28, MZ-CAT-29
- **Bridges, Tunnels & Civil Infrastructure** (Heavy-Duty Geomembrane & Polyurea Systems): Heavy civil engineering solutions for high-speed rail bridge decks, mountain tunnels, mining containment, and municipal landfills meeting the world's most rigorous engineering standards. Recommended SKUs: MZ-CAT-25, MZ-CAT-32, MZ-CAT-16, MZ-CAT-33

## Frequently Asked Questions (B2B Procurement & Technical)
### How to choose between SBS and APP modified bitumen waterproof membranes for different climates?
SBS (Styrene-Butadiene-Styrene) modified bitumen membrane (MZ-CAT-01) offers superior low-temperature flexibility down to -25°C and ≥40% elongation, making it ideal for cold and temperate regions. APP (Atactic Polypropylene) modified bitumen membrane (MZ-CAT-02) provides high heat resistance up to +130°C and strong UV stability, engineered for tropical and high-temperature regions such as the Middle East, Africa, Southeast Asia, and South America.

### How many rolls of 3mm or 4mm waterproof membrane fit in a 20GP export container?
For standard 1m × 10m modified bitumen rolls palletized at our Weifang factory: a 20GP container loads approximately 620–650 rolls (6,200–6,500 m²) of 3.0mm SBS/APP membrane, or 480–500 rolls (4,800–5,000 m²) of 4.0mm SBS/APP membrane. For 1.2mm–1.5mm Pre-Applied HDPE or TPO membranes (2m × 20m rolls), a 20GP container loads approximately 14,000–18,000 m². Standard lead time to Qingdao Port (200 km) is 7–10 days.

### What international standards do Mingze waterproofing membranes and coatings comply with?
Our 37 waterproofing products are manufactured under ISO 9001:2015 and ISO 14001:2015 quality systems and tested to comply with ASTM D6164 (SBS), ASTM D6222 (APP), ASTM D6878 (TPO), ASTM D4434 (PVC), ASTM D5385 (Pre-applied HDPE), ASTM C836 (Polyurethane coating), European CE standards EN 13707 / EN 13956, and Chinese GB standards. Batch-specific COA, TDS, and MSDS documents are supplied with every shipment.

### Do you provide OEM private-label branding and free physical sample swatch boxes?
Yes. We provide custom roll widths (1.0m / 2.0m), custom thickness, private-label PE film printing, and custom packaging for global distributors and contractors. Complimentary A4 physical membrane cuts and coating sample kits can be dispatched globally via DHL or FedEx for laboratory verification and project tender submittals.

### Which waterproofing membrane is recommended for blindside underground basements and tunnels?
For underground foundations, basements, and civil tunnels, we recommend Pre-Applied HDPE Self-Adhesive Waterproof Membrane (MZ-CAT-11, 1.2mm–2.0mm) compliant with ASTM D5385 and GB/T 23457, which forms a permanent chemical-mechanical bond with poured structural concrete to prevent lateral water migration, paired with EVA/ECB tunnel sheets (MZ-CAT-16) and HDPE dimple drainage boards (MZ-CAT-14 / MZ-CAT-34).

### How can overseas buyers request a factory FOB or CIF quotation?
Buyers can contact our export engineering desk directly via email at zhao@mzwaterproof.com (or zhao@mingzewaterproof.com) or via WhatsApp at +86 16658506707, stating the product model (e.g., MZ-CAT-01 to MZ-CAT-37), thickness, estimated quantity, and destination port. Formal FOB Qingdao or CIF quotations are issued within 24 hours.
